text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Black sleeveless halter tuxedo mini dress with deep V neck and flap pockets, dark brown-black square-toe knee boots with ankle straps.. Add ONLY these accessories: soft gathered black leather handbag; pair of slender gold hoop earrings. Closed inventory: use each listed item exactly once and add no other objects.
original_prompt: Create one photorealistic COMPLETE hollow wardrobe outfit on pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped with margins. Image 1 is the exact empty clothing ensemble; preserve its garments, shoes, materials and proportions. Image 2 is the original styling reference; use ONLY 下排中. Add ONLY this closed accessory inventory, each once: soft gathered black leather handbag; pair of slender gold hoop earrings. Style these listed accessories as in the reference using invisible supports; bag beside ensemble. No human, hair, skin, body parts, mannequin or stands. No additional belts, scarves, ties, bags, jewelry, props or clothing. No text, watermark or collage.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
